// SOURCE-BOUND PLAN/RUNNER, UNEXECUTED. Invoke only inside a separately admitted
// mounted/browser owner serving the composed current application. The fixture
// controls real HTTP/IDB boundaries, never substitutes a badge controller, list,
// entry, runtime, completion validator or owned transport. This is intentionally
// NOT wired into historical mounted v4, whose acceptance/pins remain unchanged.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
export const VISIBLE_BADGE_MOUNTED_CASES = Object.freeze([
  'simultaneous title and badge mounting', 'zero one fifty fifty-one hundred',
  'no partial second batch', 'failed and malformed second batch',
  'grouped alternate edition badge fidelity', 'account catalogue page revision change',
  'acknowledged and uncertain mutation', 'abort remount unsettled contention',
  'device Continue isolation', 'old-source negative control',
  'missing page binding preserves feed', 'pending page navigation requires reload'
]);
export async function runVisibleBadgeMountedCases({ page, fixture, currentSource, record }) {
  // The supplied owner must pin actual composed inputs including retained files.
  assert.equal(currentSource.claim, 'source-comparison-only-unqualified', 'Do not relabel an old accepted run');
  assert(currentSource.sha256 && currentSource.files.includes('platform-integrations/bounded-reader/badge-anchors.json'));
  const cases = [];
  const run = async (name, operation) => { const value = { name, outcome: 'started' }; cases.push(value); await operation(); value.outcome = 'passed'; record(value); };
  const entries = () => page.locator('article:has(a[href^="/chapter/"])');
  const unknown = async () => { for (const entry of await entries().all()) { assert.equal(await entry.locator('button[title="Read status unavailable"]').isDisabled(), true); assert.equal(await entry.locator('[aria-label="Read status unavailable"]').count(), 1); assert(!String(await entry.getAttribute('class')).includes('!border-l-green-800')); } };
  await run(casesName(0), async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'account', rows: 51, holdIdentity: true }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitIdentity(); assert.equal(await fixture.capabilityRequests(), 1); await fixture.releaseIdentity(); await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await fixture.completionRequests(), 2); });
  await run(casesName(1), async () => { for (const rows of [0, 1, 50, 51, 100]) { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'account', rows }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), rows); assert.equal(await fixture.completionRequests(), Math.ceil(rows / 50)); } await fixture.configure({ rows: 101 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); assert.equal(await fixture.completionRequests(), 0); });
  await run(casesName(2), async () => { await fixture.configure({ rows: 51, holdBatch: 2 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(2); await unknown(); await fixture.releaseBatch(2); await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), 51); });
  await run(casesName(3), async () => { for (const fault of ['http-500', 'missing-row', 'duplicate-row', 'wrong-account', 'wrong-namespace']) { await fixture.configure({ rows: 100, batchFault: { batch: 2, fault } }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(2); await unknown(); assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry read status' }).count(), 1); } });
  await run(casesName(4), async () => { await fixture.configure({ rows: 51, alternateEditions: true, completedIds: ['chapter:0', 'chapter:50'] }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); await fixture.assertRetainedGroupsAndEditions(page); assert.equal(await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as unread"]').count(), 2); assert.equal(await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as read"]').count(), 49); });
  await run(casesName(5), async () => { for (const field of ['account', 'catalogue', 'page', 'revision', 'namespace', 'selection']) { await fixture.configure({ rows: 51, holdBatch: 2 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(2); await fixture.change(field, page); await fixture.releaseBatch(2); await fixture.assertNoOldBadgePublication(page); } });
  await run(casesName(6), async () => { for (const outcome of ['acknowledged', 'uncertain']) { await fixture.configure({ rows: 1, mutation: outcome }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as read"]').click(); if (outcome === 'acknowledged') { await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as unread"]').count(), 1); } else { await unknown(); assert.equal(await fixture.mutationRequests(), 1); await fixture.assertNoAutomaticRequery(); } } });
  await run(casesName(7), async () => { for (const mode of ['account', 'device']) { await fixture.configure({ mode, rows: 1, holdBatch: 1, ignoreAbort: true }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(1); await fixture.remountTitle(page); await fixture.assertUnsettledRefusal(page); await fixture.releaseBatch(1); await fixture.assertNoBypassOwner(); } });
  await run(casesName(8), async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, extraCompletedTitleRows: 120 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); await fixture.assertOriginalDeviceContinue(page); assert.equal(await fixture.credentialedHistoryRequests(), 0); await fixture.assertSharedHistoryIsWholeTitle(); });
  await run(casesName(9), async () => { await fixture.openComparisonSource(page, '14a7bab8a925928f658fbd8ebd160b3388e4b540'); await fixture.assertBadgeContractFails(page); });
  await run(casesName(10), async () => { for (const bindingFault of ['missing', 'wrong-parent', 'wrong-id-profile', 'invalid-namespace']) { await fixture.configure({ rows: 51, bindingFault }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitChapterFeed(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), 51); await unknown(); assert.equal(await fixture.completionRequests(), 0); assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry read status' }).count(), 0); assert.match(await page.getByRole('status', { name: 'Chapter read status' }).textContent(), /Reload/); } });
  await run(casesName(11), async () => { await fixture.configure({ rows: 51, holdChapterPage: true }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitChapterPage(); await fixture.hashThenNavigationStart(page); await fixture.releaseChapterPage(); await fixture.assertNoOldBadgePublication(page); assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry read status' }).count(), 0); });
  assert.deepEqual(cases.map(value => value.name), [...VISIBLE_BADGE_MOUNTED_CASES]);
  return cases;
}
function casesName(index) { return VISIBLE_BADGE_MOUNTED_CASES[index]; }

// NEW fixture-only supplement. The original twelve native groups above remain
// byte-for-byte unchanged; none are relabeled as public-profile account support.
export const PUBLIC_DEVICE_BADGE_CASES = Object.freeze([
  'public device zero one fifty fifty-one hundred', 'public device held batch',
  'public grouped alternate editions', 'public device abort remount contention',
  'public device Continue isolation', 'public missing page binding preserves feed',
  'public pending page navigation requires reload'
]);
export async function runPublicDeviceBadgeCases({ page, fixture, record }) {
  assert.equal(fixture.profile, 'public');
  const cases = [], entries = () => page.locator('article:has(a[href^="/chapter/"])');
  const unknown = async () => { for (const entry of await entries().all()) { assert.equal(await entry.locator('button[title="Read status unavailable"]').isDisabled(), true); assert.equal(await entry.locator('[aria-label="Read status unavailable"]').count(), 1); assert(!String(await entry.getAttribute('class')).includes('!border-l-green-800')); } };
  const run = async (index, operation) => { const row = { name: PUBLIC_DEVICE_BADGE_CASES[index], profile: 'public1', outcome: 'started' }; cases.push(row); await operation(); assert.equal(await fixture.credentialedHistoryRequests(), 0); row.outcome = 'passed'; record(row); };
  await run(0, async () => { for (const rows of [0,1,50,51,100]) { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), rows); } });
  await run(1, async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, holdBatch: 1 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(1); await unknown(); await fixture.releaseBatch(1); await fixture.waitBadges(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), 51); });
  await run(2, async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, alternateEditions: true, completedIds: ['chapter:0','chapter:50'] }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); await fixture.assertRetainedGroupsAndEditions(page); assert.equal(await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as unread"]').count(), 2); assert.equal(await entries().locator('button[title="Mark as read"]').count(), 49); });
  await run(3, async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 1, holdBatch: 1, ignoreAbort: true }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBatch(1); await fixture.remountTitle(page); await fixture.assertUnsettledRefusal(page); await fixture.releaseBatch(1); await fixture.assertNoBypassOwner(); });
  await run(4, async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, extraCompletedTitleRows: 120 }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page); await fixture.assertOriginalDeviceContinue(page); await fixture.assertSharedHistoryIsWholeTitle(); });
  await run(5, async () => { for (const bindingFault of ['missing','wrong-parent','wrong-id-profile','invalid-namespace']) { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, bindingFault }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitChapterFeed(page); assert.equal(await entries().count(), 51); await unknown(); assert.equal(await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry read status' }).count(), 0); assert.match(await page.getByRole('status', { name: 'Chapter read status' }).textContent(), /Reload/); } });
  await run(6, async () => { await fixture.configure({ mode: 'device', rows: 51, holdChapterPage: true }); await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitChapterPage(); await fixture.hashThenNavigationStart(page); await fixture.releaseChapterPage(); await fixture.assertNoOldBadgePublication(page); });
  assert.deepEqual(cases.map(row => row.name), [...PUBLIC_DEVICE_BADGE_CASES]);
  return cases;
}

export async function runBadgeFrameworkCases({ page, fixture, driver, guardMode, record }) {
  assert(['installed', 'omitted-control'].includes(guardMode));
  const cases = [], installed = guardMode === 'installed';
  const run = async (name, operation) => { const row = { name, profile: fixture.profile, guardMode, outcome: 'started' }; cases.push(row); row.observations = await operation(); row.outcome = 'passed'; record(row); };
  const app = () => page.command('snapshot');
  const route = suffix => `${fixture.origin}/title/${fixture.titleId}${suffix}`;
  const epochChanged = async previous => driver.waitFor(async () => (await app()).navigationEpoch > previous, { label: 'real guard invalidated navigation epoch' });
  await fixture.configure({ mode: fixture.profile === 'public' ? 'device' : 'account', rows: 1 });
  await run('fixture XHR abort reuse body terminals', () => fixture.assertXhrAbortReuseCleanup());
  await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page);
  await run(installed ? 'real guard pending navigation' : 'guard omitted negative control', async () => {
    const before = await app();
    await fixture.beginNavigation({ href: route('?framework=pending'), hold: true }); await fixture.waitNavigation();
    const pending = await app();
    assert.equal(pending.pageUrl, before.pageUrl, 'Pending route must not be replaced by a synthetic page update');
    if (installed) assert(pending.navigationEpoch > before.navigationEpoch, 'Pending navigation did not invalidate the real guard');
    else assert.equal(pending.navigationEpoch, before.navigationEpoch, 'Omitted guard control was unexpectedly protected');
    await fixture.releaseNavigation(); const terminal = await fixture.finishNavigation();
    assert.equal(terminal.outcome, 'committed', 'Negative control must still have a healthy real router');
    return { before: before.navigationEpoch, pending: pending.navigationEpoch, terminal, expectedGuardFailureDetected: !installed };
  });
  if (!installed) return cases;
  await run('real hash event invalidates without fabricated page binding', async () => {
    const before = await app(); await page.command('hash', { hash: '#framework-hash' }); await epochChanged(before.navigationEpoch);
    const after = await app(); assert.equal(new URL(after.pageUrl).pathname, new URL(before.pageUrl).pathname);
    return { before: before.navigationEpoch, after: after.navigationEpoch, pageUrl: after.pageUrl };
  });
  await run('real cancellation stays separate from load error', async () => {
    const before = await app(), href = route('?framework=cancel');
    await page.command('cancelNextNavigation', { href }); await fixture.beginNavigation({ href, hold: false });
    const terminal = await fixture.finishNavigation();
    assert.equal(terminal.outcome, 'cancelled');
    const after = await app(); assert.equal(after.pageUrl, before.pageUrl); assert(after.navigationEpoch > before.navigationEpoch);
    return { terminal, before: before.navigationEpoch, after: after.navigationEpoch };
  });
  await run('real load error has its own router terminal', async () => {
    const before = await app(); await fixture.beginNavigation({ href: route('?framework=load-error'), error: true, hold: false });
    const terminal = await fixture.finishNavigation();
    assert.equal(terminal.outcome, 'load-error');
    // Kit may commit an error page. Never assert the cancelled-navigation URL rule here.
    const after = await app(); assert(after.navigationEpoch > before.navigationEpoch);
    return { terminal, resultingPageUrl: after.pageUrl, resultingRoute: after.routeId };
  });
  await run('real A B A transitions and guard cleanup', async () => {
    await fixture.remountGuard(page);
    const start = await driver.snapshot();
    await fixture.leaveGuard(); const outside = await driver.snapshot();
    assert.equal(outside.application.routeId, '/__badge_outside');
    assert(outside.application.navigationEpoch > start.application.navigationEpoch);
    const removes = outside.dom.listeners.slice(start.dom.listeners.length).filter(row => row.action === 'remove' && ['hashchange','popstate'].includes(row.type));
    assert(removes.some(row => row.type === 'hashchange') && removes.some(row => row.type === 'popstate'), 'Real guard listener cleanup was not observed');
    await fixture.remountGuard(page); const again = await driver.snapshot();
    assert.equal(new URL(again.application.pageUrl).pathname, `/title/${fixture.titleId}`);
    const adds = again.dom.listeners.slice(outside.dom.listeners.length).filter(row => row.action === 'add' && ['hashchange','popstate'].includes(row.type));
    assert.equal(adds.filter(row => row.type === 'hashchange').length, 1); assert.equal(adds.filter(row => row.type === 'popstate').length, 1);
    const before = await app(); await page.command('hash', { hash: '#framework-remounted' }); await epochChanged(before.navigationEpoch);
    return { start: start.application.navigationEpoch, outside: outside.application.navigationEpoch, remounted: again.application.navigationEpoch, removed: removes, added: adds };
  });
  return cases;
}

// NEW focused regressions, additional to (not replacements for) native twelve.
export const NATIVE_BADGE_TERMINAL_SUPPLEMENTS = Object.freeze([
  'returned body cancellation remains owned across same-graph remount',
  'uncertain mutation fence survives same-graph remount'
]);
export async function runNativeBadgeTerminalSupplements({ page, fixture, record }) {
  assert.equal(fixture.profile, 'native');
  const cases = [];
  const run = async (index, operation) => { const row = { name: NATIVE_BADGE_TERMINAL_SUPPLEMENTS[index], profile: 'native0', scope: 'new-terminal-regression', outcome: 'started' }; cases.push(row); await operation(); row.outcome = 'passed'; record(row); };
  await run(0, async () => {
    await fixture.configure({ mode: 'account', rows: 1, holdBodyBatch: 1, holdBodyCancel: true });
    await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBodyBatch(1);
    await fixture.remountTitleWithHeldBody(page); await fixture.waitBodyCancel(1);
    await fixture.assertBodyUnsettledRefusal(page);
    await fixture.releaseBodyRead(1); await fixture.assertBodyUnsettledRefusal(page);
    await fixture.releaseBodyCancel(1); await fixture.assertNoBodyBypassOwner();
    await fixture.retryAfterBodyTerminal(page);
  });
  await run(1, async () => {
    await fixture.configure({ mode: 'account', rows: 1, mutation: 'uncertain' });
    await fixture.openTitle(page); await fixture.waitBadges(page);
    await page.locator('article:has(a[href^="/chapter/"])').locator('button[title="Mark as read"]').click();
    await fixture.assertNoAutomaticRequery();
    await fixture.remountUncertainTitle(page); await fixture.assertUncertainFenceSurvivesRemount(page);
    assert.equal(await fixture.mutationRequests(), 1);
  });
  assert.deepEqual(cases.map(row => row.name), [...NATIVE_BADGE_TERMINAL_SUPPLEMENTS]);
  return cases;
}
